Build uji coba. Pasang ke container arm64ec yang baru.

GE-Proton 11.0-5 arm64ec (bionic) dari [The412Banner](https://github.com/The412Banner/proton-wine), ditambah userspace ntsync dari [GameNative](https://github.com/GameNative/ntsync-android).

Env var:

- `PROTON_NO_NTSYNC=1` — matikan ntsync
- `PROTON_NO_KERNEL_NTSYNC=1` — paksa backend userspace

File:

- `GE-proton-11.0-5-ntsync-arm64ec-sdk28.wcp` — GameNative / Bannerlator / WinNative
- `GE-proton-wine-11.0-5-ntsync-arm64ec-sdk28.wcp.xz` — Winlator CMOD & Ludashi

`versionName` `11.0-9-arm64ec`, jadi bisa dipasang berdampingan dengan build The412Banner asli.
